description: Integrate and optimize all Phase 1 modules into a unified, production-ready package. Fix critical issues, ensure chemical accuracy targets are met, and provide a clean API for end users.

objectives.description: Create unified package structure that integrates Tasks 001-005 into a single Python package
acceptance_criteria: Create rlqas.phase1 Python package with proper module hierarchy
All modules from Tasks 001-005 available via 'import rlqas.phase1'
Eliminate hard-coded sys.path.append imports between tasks
Provide clean entry points for common workflows
Maintain backward compatibility with existing test scripts

objectives.description: Migrate from deprecated Gym to Gymnasium
acceptance_criteria: Replace all 'import gym' with 'import gymnasium as gym'
Update environment interfaces to use Gymnasium API
Ensure UCCSearchEnv works correctly with Gymnasium
Update RL agent compatibility with Gymnasium
No Gym deprecation warnings in any module

objectives.description: Achieve chemical accuracy (<1.6 mHa error) for LiH with active_space=(2,3) and parity transformation
acceptance_criteria: LiH molecule with active_space=(2,3) processed correctly (should produce 4 qubits with parity transformation)
UCC search converges to within 1.6 mHa of FCI energy
Optimize PPO hyperparameters for chemical accuracy
Improve reward function to better balance energy improvement vs circuit complexity
Validate results with multiple random seeds for statistical significance

objectives.description: Validate all performance targets from Phase 1 specifications
acceptance_criteria: 8-qubit circuit energy evaluation completes in <500ms
Full LiH validation completes within <2 hours
Memory estimation functions provide accurate predictions
Benchmark scripts for measuring performance metrics

objectives.description: Optimize key algorithms identified in Phase 1 review
acceptance_criteria: Improve reference state calculation efficiency (replace brute-force search)
Fix Hamiltonian mapping inconsistencies between modules
Optimize CI vector engine integration in quantum simulator
Enhance error handling and logging across all modules

objectives.description: Provide comprehensive documentation and usage examples
acceptance_criteria: Create README.md with installation and quickstart instructions
Provide API documentation for all public interfaces
Create example scripts for common use cases
Generate validation report showing all targets achieved

implementation_requirements: Do not modify original Task 001-005 code directly - create new integrated structure
Maintain compatibility with existing test suites where possible
Use semantic versioning for the integrated package
Follow PEP8 standards and include type hints for public APIs
Provide both high-level and low-level APIs for different user needs
output_requirements: Integrated Python package in src/rlqas/phase1/ directory
Comprehensive test suite covering integration points
Validation report demonstrating chemical accuracy achievement
integration_points: MoleculeData objects must flow seamlessly between all modules
Quantum simulator must work with Hamiltonians from molecule processor
RL agent must interface correctly with UCC search environment
Validation system must integrate all components end-to-end
preservation_requirements: Keep original Task 001-005 directories intact as reference
Ensure integrated package can be tested independently
Maintain ability to run original validation scripts for comparison

validation_procedure.description: Comprehensive validation of integrated Phase 1 system
steps: Run module integration tests to verify all components work together
Execute chemical accuracy validation for LiH (2,3) active space
Run end-to-end validation with H2 and LiH test cases
Compare results with original Task 005 validation outputs
Generate validation report with metrics and analysis
success_criteria: Chemical accuracy <1.6 mHa achieved for LiH (2,3)
No critical warnings or errors in test execution
Validation report demonstrates all objectives achieved

notes: This is a consolidation and optimization task, not a rewrite
Focus on fixing identified issues while preserving existing functionality
Chemical accuracy may require significant hyperparameter tuning
Performance optimization should focus on critical bottlenecks identified in review
Documentation should target both researchers and developers
